description: This file contains utility functions for string matching operations such as contains, starts with, ends with, and their case-insensitive variants, implemented using absl::string_view.

methods.name: StrContains
methods.description: Checks if haystack contains the substring needle.

methods.name: StrContains
methods.description: Checks if haystack contains the character needle.

methods.name: StartsWith
methods.description: Checks if text starts with prefix.

methods.name: EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if text ends with suffix.

methods.name: StrContainsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if haystack contains needle, ignoring case.

methods.name: EqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if two ASCII strings are equal, ignoring case.

methods.name: StartsWithIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if text starts with prefix, ignoring case.

methods.name: EndsWithIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if text ends with suffix, ignoring case.
